[!race] skip 'the race detector is not supported on this platform'
[!cgo] skip 'the race detector needs cgo'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=1

! logos run -race ./mixedrace
stderr 'WARNING: DATA RACE'
stderr 'main\.Rec\.MarshalJSON'
stderr 'main\.\(\*Rec\)\.UnmarshalJSON'

! logos run -race ./unmarshalrace
stderr 'WARNING: DATA RACE'
stderr 'main\.\(\*Rec\)\.UnmarshalJSON'

logos run -race ./locked
stdout '^locked ok$'
! stderr 'DATA RACE'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/jsonrace

go 1.27

-- mixedrace/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
)

type Rec struct {
	Count *int64 `json:"count"`
}

func marshalLoop(r *Rec) {
	for range 200 {
		_, err := r.MarshalJSON()
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
	}
}

func unmarshalLoop(r *Rec) {
	for range 200 {
		err := r.UnmarshalJSON([]byte(`{"count":7}`))
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
	}
}

func run() error {
	count := int64(3)
	r := &Rec{Count: &count}
	go group (context.Background()) {
		go marshalLoop(r)
		go unmarshalLoop(r)
	}
	fmt.Println("mixed ok")
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

-- unmarshalrace/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
)

type Rec struct {
	Count *int64 `json:"count"`
}

func unmarshalLoop(r *Rec) {
	for range 200 {
		err := r.UnmarshalJSON([]byte(`{"count":7}`))
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
	}
}

func run() error {
	count := int64(3)
	r := &Rec{Count: &count}
	go group (context.Background()) {
		go unmarshalLoop(r)
		go unmarshalLoop(r)
	}
	fmt.Println("unmarshal ok")
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

-- locked/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"sync"
)

type Rec struct {
	Count *int64 `json:"count"`
}

func marshalLoop(r *Rec, mu *sync.Mutex) {
	for range 200 {
		mu.Lock()
		_, err := r.MarshalJSON()
		mu.Unlock()
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
	}
}

func unmarshalLoop(r *Rec, mu *sync.Mutex) {
	for range 200 {
		mu.Lock()
		err := r.UnmarshalJSON([]byte(`{"count":7}`))
		mu.Unlock()
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
	}
}

func run() error {
	count := int64(3)
	r := &Rec{Count: &count}
	var mu sync.Mutex
	go group (context.Background()) {
		go marshalLoop(r, &mu)
		go unmarshalLoop(r, &mu)
		go unmarshalLoop(r, &mu)
	}
	fmt.Println("locked ok")
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
